description: freshness.json of an audience folder of the published folder (exec/, manager/<key>/, person/<key>/): when it was assembled, which frozen months it holds, how far the data goes and which sources are stale. Generated from meterline_job/schemas.py; do not edit by hand.

data_through.description: the earliest complete_through over the sources; null when any is unknown

frozen_months.description: the frozen months this folder shows

published_at.description: when the published folder was assembled (UTC)

stale_sources.description: the names of the stale sources (a failed step in this run, or older than stale_after_days)
